restore_bpe_segmentation: restore a BPE segmented sentence back to its original tokenization using fastbpe, roberta, or sentencepiece mode
batch_sentences_to_tensor: batch a list of sentence tensors into a padded tensor with EOS markers and length vectors
add_noise_to_encoder_input: add noise to encoder input by shuffling, dropping, and blanking words with configurable parameters
parse_lambda_schedule_config: parse a lambda coefficient schedule configuration string and compute interpolated values for training iterations
convert_batch_to_text: convert a batch of tokenized sentence tensors back to a list of readable text sentences using a dictionary
